name: positional_arg_test
description: Minimal test: positional vs named input binding for bars reporters
source:
# Positional argument binding test
# Tests whether bars inputs can be bound by position instead of name

src = study_assets()
close = src.c
daily_ret = (close - (close >> 1)) / (close >> 1)
cum_ret = agg(daily_ret, AggregationType.Sum)
sma_20 = sma(close, 20)
sma_50 = sma(close, 50)
month_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.month)(index())
ones = close / close
up_day = 1.0 if daily_ret > 0 else 0.0
down_day = 1.0 if daily_ret <= 0 else 0.0

# ========================================================================
# TEST 1: cs_bars single value — named vs positional
# ========================================================================
# 1a: NAMED (baseline)
cs_bars(mode=CSBarMode.simple, agg=AggregationType.Last, category='T1a named single')(values=close)

# 1b: POSITIONAL — single value at index 0 → values
cs_bars(mode=CSBarMode.simple, agg=AggregationType.Last, category='T1b positional single')(close)

# ========================================================================
# TEST 2: cs_bars two args — named vs positional
# ========================================================================
# 2a: NAMED (baseline)
cs_bars(mode=CSBarMode.stacked, agg=AggregationType.Mean, label_as_x_axis=True, x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month, category='T2a named two')(values=daily_ret, label=month_num)

# 2b: POSITIONAL — arg0 → values, arg1 → label
cs_bars(mode=CSBarMode.stacked, agg=AggregationType.Mean, label_as_x_axis=True, x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month, category='T2b positional two')(daily_ret, month_num)

# ========================================================================
# TEST 3: xy_bars single value + label — named vs positional
# ========================================================================
# 3a: NAMED (baseline)
xy_bars(mode=BarMode.labeled, agg=AggregationType.Mean, x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month, category='T3a named single+label')(values=daily_ret, label=month_num)

# 3b: POSITIONAL — already used in original def (daily_ret, label=month_num)
xy_bars(mode=BarMode.labeled, agg=AggregationType.Mean, x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month, category='T3b mixed positional+named')(daily_ret, label=month_num)

# 3c: FULLY POSITIONAL — arg0 → values, arg1 → label
xy_bars(mode=BarMode.labeled, agg=AggregationType.Mean, x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month, category='T3c fully positional')(daily_ret, month_num)

# ========================================================================
# TEST 4: xy_bars tuple values — named vs positional
# ========================================================================
# 4a: NAMED (baseline)
xy_bars(mode=BarMode.series, agg=AggregationType.Last, series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[BarSeriesSpec(name='SMA 20', color=Color.Blue), BarSeriesSpec(name='SMA 50', color=Color.Gray)]), category='T4a named tuple')(values=(sma_20, sma_50))

# 4b: POSITIONAL — tuple literal as arg0 → values
xy_bars(mode=BarMode.series, agg=AggregationType.Last, series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[BarSeriesSpec(name='SMA 20', color=Color.Blue), BarSeriesSpec(name='SMA 50', color=Color.Gray)]), category='T4b positional tuple')((sma_20, sma_50))

# ========================================================================
# TEST 5: xy_bars tuple + label — named vs positional
# ========================================================================
# 5a: NAMED (baseline)
xy_bars(mode=BarMode.labeled, agg=AggregationType.Sum, x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month, stack_type=StackType.NormalStack, series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[BarSeriesSpec(name='Up', color=Color.Green), BarSeriesSpec(name='Down', color=Color.Red)]), category='T5a named tuple+label')(values=(up_day, down_day), label=month_num)

# 5b: POSITIONAL — tuple arg0 → values, arg1 → label
xy_bars(mode=BarMode.labeled, agg=AggregationType.Sum, x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month, stack_type=StackType.NormalStack, series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[BarSeriesSpec(name='Up', color=Color.Green), BarSeriesSpec(name='Down', color=Color.Red)]), category='T5b positional tuple+label')((up_day, down_day), month_num)
